# assets/

Icon and QSS-referenced image sources.

## Tracked files

- `logo.svg` — application icon source, rendered to `UltraVivid.ico` by
  [SVG to ICO](../setup/__about/svg_to_ico.md)
- `check.svg` — the checkbox check glyph, read directly by
  [Theme](../gui/__about/theme.md)'s QSS (`QCheckBox::indicator:checked`)

## Generated files

- `UltraVivid.ico` — generated by `setup/svg_to_ico.py` from `logo.svg`
  (gitignored, rebuilt on each build)

## Connections

### Used by
- [Setup (folder)](../setup/___setup.md) — icon generation
- [Theme](../gui/__about/theme.md) — the check glyph
